notes: L1-5 export function formatDuration(min: number): string — ported verbatim: L2 const h = Math.floor(min / 60), L3 const m = Math.round(min % 60), L4 return h > 0 ? `${h}h ${m}m` : `${m}m`. Pure numeric/string logic, no DOM/browser deps; consumed by DriveStatCards + DriveTimeline.
L6 blank line preserved as the separator between the function and the constant.

L7 export const LEGEND_STYLE = { fontSize: 10, color: '#9ca3af' } as const — ported verbatim (as const literal typing kept). Web uses it as Recharts <Legend wrapperStyle={LEGEND_STYLE}>; the fontSize/color shape is also a valid React Native TextStyle, so it is native-safe and reusable when ElevationChart/TemperatureSection/TirePressureSection are ported. No Recharts/Leaflet/DOM import introduced.
